title: Custom Select option renderers must reuse getSelectStyles, not hand-rolled CSS
answers: TimeZonePicker looks different/inconsistent from other Select dropdowns
Custom select option component doesn't show focus ring or selected state correctly
Why does this select option ignore the base Select styling/accessibility fixes?
How should a custom option component for Select be styled?
body:
Symptom: TimeZonePicker's dropdown options had custom hover/selected styling (own padding, border-radius, checkmark icon) that looked and behaved differently from the base Select, and missed accessibility fixes (e.g. focus ring) applied to Select generally.
Root cause: WideTimeZoneOption/CompactTimeZoneOption in packages/grafana-ui/src/components/DateTimePickers/TimeZonePicker/TimeZoneOption.tsx defined their own `container`/`containerFocused` styles and manually rendered an Icon for isSelected instead of using the shared Select option styles.
Fix pattern: replace custom container/focus/selected CSS with classes from getSelectStyles (packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Select/getSelectStyles.ts): `option`, `optionFocused`, `optionFocusRing` (gated on `selectProps?.showFocusRing`), `optionSelected`, `optionDisabled`. Drop manual checkmark rendering since `optionSelected` style communicates selection like native Select options; accept and thread through a `selectProps` prop with `showFocusRing`.
Constraints: applies to any custom `components.Option` passed into react-select based Select/Combobox; do not reintroduce bespoke hover/selected CSS in option renderers, since it will drift from future base-Select accessibility/style updates (see #130740).
applies: grafana-ui components that render custom option UI for Select-based pickers

search: Custom option renderers for react-select based Select/Combobox components (custom components.Option) must reuse CSS classes from getSelectStyles in packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Select/getSelectStyles.ts rather than hand-rolling hover, focus, and selected styles. Use the shared classes: option, optionFocused, optionFocusRing (gated on selectProps?.showFocusRing), optionSelected, and optionDisabled; drop manual checkmark Icon rendering since optionSelected communicates selection like the base Select. Thread through a selectProps prop with showFocusRing to preserve accessibility fixes (focus rings, etc.) that the base Select receives in future updates. Custom CSS in option renderers (like TimeZonePicker's WideTimeZoneOption) drifts from base-Select behavior and misses accessibility fixes.
